deadline.value: The 2026/27 Spring round closed 20 March 2026 and the Fall round 20 August 2026. The 2027 call is not yet published.

gre_subject.value: The information sheet names no GRE Subject test; selection is by academic qualifications and an exam.

also.quote: Admission: Academic and scientific qualifications + essay + oral exam (remote)

supervisor.value: Informal inquiries go to the PhD coordinator and/or a prospective supervisor; the page does not say a supervisor's agreement is needed for admission.
supervisor.quote: please contact the PhD Coordinator Mathew Diamond (diamond@sissa.it) and/or your prospective supervisor

funding.value: Every admitted candidate receives a SISSA fellowship for the whole course; the FAQ gives EUR 1,120 net a month.
funding.quote: All admitted candidates will receive a fellowship of the amount of € 1.120,00 net per month.

also.quote: Ai candidati ammessi verrà attribuita una borsa di studio ... per tutta la durata del corso

entry_route.value: A Master's (or equivalent) degree must be held by the start of the course; a 4-year bachelor's is sometimes judged eligible by the Senate.
entry_route.quote: Yes you can, but you will have to obtain the Master degree (or equivalent) by the beginning of the courses.

also.quote: Usually a B.Sc. Hons. or a 4-year (or more) B.Sc. are sufficient.

notes: Covers Cognitive Neuroscience only. Neurobiology has its own call and is not covered here.
